source.title: Dragonflight priority ore prospecting and herb milling numerical baseline search

notes: No newly found independent input-rank-controlled per-output completed-cast hit counts, units or 0/1/2+ outcome histograms for the priority ores or herbs. Previously known Xenastro, Bugy, ar_rules, superbondez, Lazy Goldmaker and Reddit cohorts were NOT re-recorded. Search covered six-plus distinct named-item query families and three-plus independent sites; retain all denominator and refunded-input uncertainties.
lookingFor: New completed-cast, rank- and skill-resolved original Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling hit counts and yield histograms
whereLooked: reddit.com/r/woweconomy: named Draconium Ore raw prospecting spreadsheets, pooled quality gem totals, Xenastro original posts (no new independent rank-matched completed casts)
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: Serevite Ore 2022–2023 actual completed prospects, rank-specific zero/1/2 outcomes; known ar_rules/108782r families only
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting 20-cast diamond zero sample; source previously collected, no new rank-isolated histograms
wowhead.com: Prismatic Ore prospecting Eternity Amber, Illimited Diamond rank and source comments; existing superbondez cohort, no new per-cast hits
wowhead.com: Bubble Poppy milling pigment output counts original table; no independent sampled per-mill output distribution
warcraft.wiki.gg and wow-professions.com: Saxifrage milling outputs, recipes, skill/specialization; reference identities/rules only, no new raw casts
github.com: Dragonflight ore prospecting CSV/spreadsheet exports, materials per cast; no new eligible original per-operation dataset
